## Ignored paths

These paths contain dependencies or generated outputs. They do not contain maintained documentation sources.

| Reason | Glob |
| --- | --- |
| Third-party dependencies | `node_modules/**/*.md` |
| Generated outputs | `dist/**/*.md` |

| Local Python environment | `.venv/**/*.md` |
| Nimbus collection generated from classified sources | `docs-nimbus/src/content/docs/**/*.md` |
| Third-party Nimbus dependencies | `docs-nimbus/node_modules/**/*.md` |
| Generated Nimbus site | `docs-nimbus/dist/**/*.md` |
